# Synonym data and examples

Open English WordNet 2025, Open English WordNet Community; CC BY 4.0. Synsets and derivational relations extracted from the official WN-LMF release. English synset meanings are authoritative. Chinese glosses are included only with a sense match. Examples also use Open Dictionary v2.0 / Wiktionary (CC BY-SA 4.0), OEWN source phrase adaptations, and wordlilium-authored sentences. Unsupported rows are not displayed. Synonyms are not guaranteed interchangeable in sentences. https://en-word.net/downloads ; https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

Only rows with an attested or explicitly authored sense example are displayed. Generic dictionary glosses are removed; English synset meaning is authoritative. Context matching is heuristic, not a claim of human review of all entries.
